cell.sampling: T 1.0, top-p 1.0, min-p 0; problem i seeded 5,000,000 + i

cells.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.wsp_edit --recipe interp --other think_sft --alpha 1.0 --rounding nearest --seed 0 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label think_sft_cue_cap8k --prompt cue --set math500 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --max-tokens 8192 --seed 5000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)

readouts.readout: fraction of W problems whose new answer is v3-wrong or a cap hit

cell.model: allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B (untrained base)
cell.prompt: cue + 3 solved examples written by the cued base in context (run_cell --shots with the base-written draw-2 json of shots1b), so the prompt context differs from the stored cued samples
cell.n: 494 (MATH-500 without the example problems); readout on G = problems where at least two of the four stored cued samples (day1_3 math500_base_cue-01, attempt 0) are finished wrong answers that agree under rln4_lib.agree (about 40)
cell.sampling: T 1.0, top-p 1.0, min-p 0; problem i seeded 7,000,000 + i

cells.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model base --prompt cue --set math500 --shots <shots1b base-written draw-2 json> --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 7000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)

readouts.readout: right answers (v3, cap hits wrong) on the problems of G

best_base.note: no board count exists on G. Estimate: the cued base's mean right rate on G (about 0.2; at most 0.5 by construction) times |G| of about 40 gives 8. Scaled by the best one-sample base cell (430 against the cue's 410, result-882fa7), that is about 9.
